who_i_am_desc:
I'm a computer science student at {EPITECH.} because I like programming, innovation and create things.

I'm looking for an internship for 4 months starting 1er avril 2021.

When I received my first computer, I wanted to know how software, video games and computers were created.

Curious, I'm always looking news about robotic, programming and video games.
My goal is to combine work and passion.

Autonomous, motivated and effective, I'm looking to join a company or work as freelance to get some experiences and learn new technologies.

projects.desc:
Windows snipping tool like created using Visual Studio and C#.
You just have to take a screenshot and then you can edit it or send it to your friends.
The goal of this project is to be very handy.

projects.title: Syntek
projects.desc:
Chrome & Firefox extension in the way to help Epitech's students with their lessons calendar, using JavaScript and HTML/CSS.
With this extension, you can check your Epitech Planning from anywhere with a little icon in the top bar and whenever you open a new tab, you'll see your next events so you can never miss them!

Furthermore, you'll be alerted when an event has almost started.

projects.title: Flappy Bird
projects.desc:
Remake of 'Flappy Bird' the game with CSFML (in C) for 1 day.
I wanted to challenge myself in an afternoon, so I take a graphic pack of Flappy Bird and did a remake of it in C. The pipe height is random and the map is customisable.

projects.title: My Hunter
projects.desc:
Remake of 'Dunk Hunt' the game with CSFML (in C) for 21 days.
We were free to use any graphic style.
The rules were just to display a sprite which moving, with a score and some collisions when we shot at a monster.

projects.title: My Runner
projects.desc:
It's a 'Runner Game' style game with CSFML (in C) for 42 days.
We were free to use any graphic style.
The rules were to display a sprite which moving, with a score, some collisions and the handling of an external map. (a text file which represents the map)

projects.title: 42sh
projects.desc:
The goal of this project is to recreate 'Tcsh', a Linux shell.
We have to handle all the basic commands, environment commands, pipes, redirections, history...
